about.title: Help and setup
about.nanoTitle: Turn on Gemini Nano in Chrome (on-device AI)
about.req: Needs desktop Chrome 139 or newer on Windows 10/11, macOS 13+, Linux or a Chromebook Plus; 22 GB free disk; and a GPU with more than 4 GB VRAM, or 16 GB RAM with 4+ CPU cores.
about.flag1: Open chrome://flags/#prompt-api-for-gemini-nano-multimodal-input and set it to Enabled.
about.flag2: If on-device AI still shows as unavailable, also set chrome://flags/#optimization-guide-on-device-model to "Enabled BypassPerfRequirement".
about.flag3: Restart Chrome, open LabLens and click "Enable on-device AI". The first download takes a few minutes.
about.offline: Install LabLens (the install icon in Chrome's address bar). Once Gemini Nano has downloaded, everything except the cloud features works without internet.
about.limits1: Gemini Nano writes English (and a few other languages) but not Hindi or Marathi yet. Value explanations are translated by LabLens itself; Hindi/Marathi summaries use the cloud on redacted data.
about.limits2: Typical reference ranges are for adults. Children, pregnancy and lab-specific methods can differ: the range printed on your report always wins.
about.limits3: Reading handwriting is unreliable. Always check the extracted values against your report.
about.disclaimer: LabLens gives general educational information. It does not diagnose, prescribe or replace a doctor. In an emergency call 108 or go to the nearest hospital.
about.data: Delete all data on this device
